dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Low-contrast, thin pale fringes are visible along the outer edges of the folded feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct, concentrated region of rufous/orange plumage forming a high-contrast patch on the lateral nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Indistinct; a monochromatic grey transition with no visible linear boundary or color shift separating the crown from the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: The tail feathers exhibit a high-contrast pattern of large, white elliptical spots on a dark ground color.
